axes.label: decision-boundary behavior
axes.interpretation: Primary behavioral axis; it is not a truth score.

axes.label: style and language
axes.interpretation: Separate descriptive language overlap from decision-boundary behavior.

axes.label: usefulness and caution trade-off
axes.interpretation: A cautious answer can still fail if it refuses a licensed conclusion; no total score hides this trade-off.

human_review_policy: If structured claim events or the required boundary annotations are absent, return HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED rather than using an LLM judge or guessing from tone.
terminology_policy: Repeating K13, M/E, Claim Ceiling, unknown or related vocabulary never increases a decision-boundary metric.
